_comment: Which golden rules are promoted out of their chapter and into the two headline
tiers of the viva deck. Read by tools/viva-extract.php; the order here is the
order they appear in GOLDEN-RULES.md and in the deck, so it is rehearsal order,
This is the one editorial judgement in an otherwise generated pipeline. The test
for 'twelve': would a Java/Spring interview in Modena or Bologna plausibly turn on
whether the candidate can say this out loud? The test for 'senior': does knowing it
show you have operated a system rather than only built one?
Every entry must be a slug that tools/viva-extract.php --candidates prints. A slug
that no longer exists is reported as a WARNING rather than silently dropped.
